build_mobilevit_backbone: build a MobileViT backbone model with small, x_small, or xx_small architecture settings
create_mobilevit_block: create a MobileVitBlock with local convolution and global transformer representation layers
build_mobilenetv2_layer: build a MobileNetV2 layer with InvertedResidual blocks for feature extraction
build_mobilevit_layer: build a MobileViT layer combining InvertedResidual and MobileVitBlock for hybrid conv-transformer features
freeze_mobilevit_stages: freeze specific stages of the MobileViT backbone to fix parameters during training
